contract: one font file read from memory; every face of a collection opened with FreeType and set up as libass 0.17.5 sets up its faces with hinting off (ASS_HINTING_NONE): its charmap (ass_charmap_magic), GDI face metrics (set_font_metrics) and a REAL_DIM size request of 256 pixels (16384 in 26.6, ass_face_set_size)

a HarfBuzz font over the face's tables (ass_create_hb_font) with libass's font functions (init_font_funcs, get_hb_font): ass_font_index_magic and FT_Get_Char_Index or FT_Face_GetCharVariantIndex for glyphs; FT_LOAD_DEFAULT | FT_LOAD_IGNORE_GLOBAL_ADVANCE_WIDTH | FT_LOAD_IGNORE_TRANSFORM metrics, cached per glyph, for advances and extents; that load's outline for contour points; FT_KERNING_DEFAULT kerning; the scale (x and y scale times units per em, shifted down by 16) and ppem of the size; the font is not an @ font
in triergon-shape with SizedMetrics over triergon-font's Font::at_size(16384)

every text of the case shaped as one run as in shape-text: hb_buffer_add_utf32 with the item and its context, the case's direction, script, language and global features in order; per text the glyph count, then every glyph's id, cluster, x and y advance and x and y offset; packets count glyphs and bytes the code points of the items

a face the candidate cannot open or set up, a text it cannot parse and a run it cannot shape are recorded as such, so the case fails; the file is read before each timed and memory operation and the FreeType library is created once, outside it
pending_module_requirements: FreeType's hinted load (FT_LOAD_DEFAULT) for glyph extents, which fallback mark positioning reads in fonts without GPOS mark positioning

open_cases.requirement: FreeType's hinted load (FT_LOAD_DEFAULT) for glyph extents, which fallback mark positioning reads in fonts without GPOS mark positioning
